# Slim ANLZ fixtures for PSSI (song structure) tests

Extracted from [rekordcrate](https://github.com/Holzhaus/rekordcrate) / [pyrekordbox](https://github.com/dylanljones/pyrekordbox) sample USB exports. Each file is a minimal `PMAI` header plus the `PSSI` tag only.

| File | Phrases | Mood |
|------|---------|------|
| `sweep.pssi.anlz` | 8 | high (1) |
| `demo_p016.pssi.anlz` | 19 | mid (2) |
| `demo_p053.pssi.anlz` | 11 | mid (2) |
